title: Contrast-enhanced CBCT With C-arm HyperSight Technology
official: Contrast-enhanced CBCT With C-arm HyperSight Technology: A Feasibility Study
summary: This is a single-arm prospective, feasibility study evaluating the intravenous contrast-enhanced cone beam computed tomography (IV CBCT) for image guidance during radiotherapy. Patients treated with SFRT will receive IV-contrast enhanced CT and fMRI before treatment for simulation purposes. Additionally, patients will receive mpMRI just before and IV-contrast enhanced CBCT during their second and last fraction of RT, in addition to the standard of care CBCT that is acquired for daily image-guided patient positioning. Patients will undergo both IV-contrast enhanced CBCT and treatment on the TrueBeam with HyperSight imaging capability. We hypothesize IV contrast enhanced CBCT is feasible, well-tolerated by patients and improves the visibility of the target.

interventions.name: Intravenous contrast-enhanced cone beam computed tomography

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Primary biopsy-proven cancer
* Planning to undergo spatially fractionated radiation therapy
* Able to provide informed consent
* Willingness to participate in follow-up
* ECOG less than or equal to 3
* Normal creatinine (below 109mmol/L), normal eGF

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unable to understand/provide consent
* History of allergic reaction to iodinated IV contrast dye (allergy to MR contrast is not an exclusion criteria)
* Known renal disease
* Single kidney
* Kidney transplant
* Dialysis
* Contraindication to MRI
